verdicts.title: Univariate polynomial real root isolation: Continued Fractions revisited
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We present algorithmic, complexity and implementation results concerning real root isolation of integer univariate polynomials using the continued fraction expansion of real algebraic numbers. One motivation is to explain the method's good performance in practice. verdicts.title: Heavy-ion double-charge-exchange and its relation to neutrinoless double-beta decay
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We introduce the formalism to describe heavy-ion Double-Charge-Exchange (DCE) processes in the eikonal approximation.
